dispatch: Session 310 sealed The Desk's numbers to source: every figure now flows through lib/news-stats.mjs into a byte-checked stats file, so accuracy reads "Not yet — a record needs 4" rather than a flattering guess, and the canned "desk disagrees" line was retired for a stance axis that shows where each voice actually stands. Reader signal — Changed my mind, Made me laugh, and three siblings — now feeds ORSON's Director's Report, identity-free. The endpoint waits in the Forge, held at the gate by 0/43 relying parties on Passport v2.
